works.author: Bato UI/UX
works.comment: AI 生图产品的 refine 流程很直观，4 张候选一字排开、点一张继续细化，值得抄这个交互。
works.comment_en: The AI image-gen product's refine flow is intuitive: four candidates in a row, tap one to keep refining — worth stealing this interaction.
works.title: Loopie – AI Creative Platform UI

works.author: Olya Marchak
works.comment: 深色毛玻璃配星空底的财务仪表盘，最高/最低余额双标记的曲线处理很干净。
works.comment_en: Finance dashboard in dark frosted glass over a starry backdrop; the high/low balance double-markers on the curve are handled cleanly.
works.title: Financial Dashboard UI Design

works.author: SM Rubel
works.comment: 黄绿黑三屏撞色很抢眼，点单链路从首页推荐到加购一气呵成，还带了个 AI Mode 搜索入口。
works.comment_en: Yellow-green-black clashing across three screens grabs the eye; the ordering flow runs from home recommendations to add-to-cart in one breath, with an AI Mode search entry to boot.
works.title: Coffee Shop App UI/UX Design – Modern Coffee Ordering App

works.author: Sheikh Raihan UI
works.comment: 新手引导用高饱和撞色加插画吉祥物，一屏一句卖点，适合抄 onboarding 的节奏。
works.comment_en: Onboarding in high-saturation clashing colors with an illustrated mascot — one selling point per screen, a rhythm worth stealing for onboarding.
works.title: AI Language Learning Onboarding — Mobile UI

works.author: Pixcut Studio UI/UX
works.comment: 落地页文案很反骨头，荧光撞色加首屏直接贴产品仪表盘，说服力拉满。
works.comment_en: The landing-page copy has real attitude; neon clashes plus the product dashboard right in the first screen — persuasion maxed out.
works.title: AI-Powered Fintech SaaS Website Design

works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 资产页把余额、周曲线、币种列表压进一屏，留白和字阶都很克制。
works.comment_en: The assets page compresses balance, weekly curve, and coin list into one screen — restrained whitespace and type scale throughout.
works.title: Crypto Portfolio Tracker Mobile App Design
